reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

title.narrative: Access to Education for Out-of-School Children in Balochistan

description.narrative: The project will support out-of-school and at-risk children and adolescents in the most deprived districts of Balochistan (Killa Abdullah, Killa Saifullah, Pishin, Quetta, Zhob); by expanding access to Accelerated Learning Programmes (ALPs) and Remedial Learning and Catch-Up (RLCP) camps. The intervention will be implemented by UNICEF in partnership with the School Education Department (SED) Government of Balochistan, leveraging existing provincial systems for ALP curriculum, teacher training, assessment and non-formal education (NFE) governance. Strengthened gender equality is an explicit objective of the agreement. The project prioritizes girls (60% of beneficiaries) and addresses gender-specific barriers through targeted outreach, recruitment of female facilitators, gender-responsive WASH facilities, menstrual hygiene support, and community engagement to promote girls’ enrolment, retention, and learning outcomes. Disability inclusion is operationalized through specific and concrete measures.
